pictures.scene: Friedrich, Woman before the Rising Sun — a woman in a long dark dress standing on a dark heath with her arms opened low before a gold sky breaking over low hills, and a great sign appeared in heaven, a woman clothed in the sun
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_woman_rising_sun

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, The Starry Night — a great white moon low at the left and blazing stars swirling through a deep blue sky above a black cypress and a village with a spire, with the moon under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_the_starry_night

pictures.scene: Ghirlandaio, The Visitation — Mary in a blue cloak bending over the kneeling Elizabeth in gold, both haloed, a walled city and a bay showing through the stone arch behind them, she was pregnant and crying out, in the pain and agony of giving birth
pictures.name: pd_ghirlandaio_visitation

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint George and the Dragon — an armored knight on a white horse driving his lance into a dark winged dragon among rocks and slender trees, a far tower on the hill behind, then another sign appeared in heaven, a huge red dragon with seven heads
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_george_and_the_dragon

pictures.scene: Turner, Donati's Comet over Oxford — a bright white comet with a long curved tail hanging low in a blue evening sky above a wooded plain, ten horns and seven royal crowns on his heads, his tail swept a third of the stars from the sky
pictures.name: pd_turner_oxford_donatis_comet

pictures.scene: Stubbs, Horse Frightened by a Lion — a pale cream horse rearing back in terror on a rocky slope with its mane and tail flying, tossing them to the earth, and the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth
pictures.name: pd_stubbs_horse_frightened_by_a_lion

pictures.scene: Morisot, The Cradle — a mother in dark blue resting her cheek on her hand and watching her sleeping baby through the white veil of a cradle, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth, and she gave birth to a son, a male child
pictures.name: pd_morisot_the_cradle

pictures.scene: A gold crown and a staff on the steps of an open door — a crown and a long staff lying together on worn stone steps before an open double door giving onto a lit sky and a distant tower, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter, and her child was caught up to God and to His throne
pictures.name: crown_and_staff_1

pictures.scene: Corot, Hagar in the Wilderness — a woman in a dark blue robe and white headcloth raising both arms toward a small white winged angel flying over yellow cliffs and dry scrub, and the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her
pictures.name: pd_corot_hagar_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Allston, Elijah in the Desert — an old man in pale robes crouched on brown ground taking food from a flying black raven, a dead white tree beside him and snow mountains far off, to be nourished for 1,260 days, then a war broke out in heaven
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint Michael — the haloed archangel in armor with dark wings and his sword raised, a white shield with a red cross on his arm, standing on a winged grey dragon above monsters and a burning city, Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_michael

pictures.scene: Moran, The Chasm of the Colorado — a vast canyon of red-brown buttes under falling rain and drifting mist with a faint rainbow, the gorge plunging away below, but the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels
pictures.name: pd_moran_the_chasm_of_the_colorado

pictures.scene: Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — a gold-armored archangel with red and gold wings raising his sword over the horned red-eyed dragon-devil he treads on, a kneeling donor with an open book at the left, and the great dragon was hurled down, that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_saint_michael_triumphant_over_the_devil

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Limbo — Christ with a red-cross banner reaching his hand down to a white-bearded haloed man, the broken door lying flat with a small black devil crushed beneath it, the deceiver of the whole world, he was hurled to the earth and his angels with him
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_limbo

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Singing Angels — eight angels in jewelled headbands and heavy red brocade copes singing from an open book on a carved wooden lectern, and I heard a loud voice in heaven saying, now have come the salvation and the power
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Taull, Christ in Majesty — a Romanesque apse fresco of Christ in a blue mandorla, his right hand raised in blessing and an open book in his left reading I am the light of the world, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ
pictures.name: pd_taull_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Poussin, Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery — Christ in a red cloak over blue pointing down at the pavement while a woman in white sits with her head bowed at the left and her accusers crowd in at the right, for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, he who accuses them day and night before our God
pictures.name: pd_poussin_christ_and_the_woman_taken_in_adultery

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing on a red-draped altar with its blood running into a gold chalice, angels kneeling around it with the cross and the column and an octagonal fountain in front, they have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Martyrdom of Saint Ursula — the saint in a red cloak looking down at the arrow in her breast with her hands cupped at the wound, soldiers' faces half lit in the darkness behind her, and they did not love their lives, so as to shy away from death
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_martyrdom_of_saint_ursula

pictures.scene: Grunewald, The Concert of Angels — a carved Gothic canopy of red and gold where a white-winged angel kneels playing a great viol and another in rose plays a violin, a host of haloed angel faces above and a crowned woman shining in orange light at the right, therefore rejoice O heavens, and you who dwell in them
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_the_concert_of_angels

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Sea of Ice — great slabs of shattered ice thrust up in a heap over the crushed timbers of a ship under a cold pale sky, but woe to the earth and the sea, with great fury the devil has come down to you
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_sea_of_ice

pictures.scene: Church, Twilight in the Wilderness — burning red cloud streaming across the whole sky above a dark still lake and low wooded hills with the last yellow light along the horizon, knowing he has only a short time, and when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth
pictures.name: pd_church_twilight_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Liljefors, Sea Eagles — two sea eagles with great dark wings beating low over grey storm water, one dropping on the other with its talons open, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child, but the woman was given two wings of a great eagle
pictures.name: pd_liljefors_sea_eagles

pictures.scene: Gerard David, The Rest on the Flight into Egypt — the Virgin in deep blue seated by the roadside holding the Child, who reaches for a bunch of green grapes, a wooded country and a far village behind them, to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time and times and half a time
pictures.name: pd_gerard_david_rest_on_the_flight_into_egypt

pictures.scene: De la Corte, The Israelites Crossing the Red Sea — a gold chariot and its horses going down in dark water while a man in red throws up his arms and drowning soldiers reach out of the flood, the people safe in a line on the far shore, then from the mouth of the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent
pictures.name: pd_de_la_corte_the_israelites_crossing_the_red_sea

pictures.scene: Danby, The Avon Gorge at Sunset — a wooded cliff and a smoking tower dark against an orange evening sky above a pale river, two labourers breaking the ground in the foreground, but the earth helped the woman, and opened its mouth to swallow up the river
pictures.name: pd_danby_avon_gorge_at_sunset

pictures.scene: Van Schrieck, Serpents and Insects — a spotted snake coiled on the dark forest floor with its mouth open among toadstools and pale moths, that had poured from the dragon's mouth, and the dragon was enraged at the woman
pictures.name: pd_van_schrieck_serpents_and_insects

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Holy Virgins — a crowd of crowned young women in white and blue carrying palm branches, one holding a basket of flowers and one a little gold tower, walking over green meadow grass, and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_holy_virgins

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Monk by the Sea — one small dark-robed figure standing on a pale strip of dune before a black sea under an immense grey and blue sky, and hold to the testimony of Jesus, and the dragon stood on the shore of the sea
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_monk_by_the_sea

lines.text: And a great sign appeared in heaven:
a woman clothed in the sun,
with the moon under her feet
and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was pregnant and crying out
in the pain and agony of giving birth.
Then another sign appeared in heaven:
a huge red dragon with seven heads,
ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky,
tossing them to the earth.
And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth,
ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
And she gave birth to a son, a male child,
who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.
And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
And the woman fled into the wilderness,
where God had prepared a place for her
to be nourished for 1,260 days.
Then a war broke out in heaven:
Michael and his angels fought against the dragon,
and the dragon and his angels fought back.
But the dragon was not strong enough,
and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
And the great dragon was hurled down,
that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan,
the deceiver of the whole world.
He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying:
Now have come the salvation and the power
and the kingdom of our God,
and the authority of His Christ.
For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down,
he who accuses them day and night before our God.
They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb
and by the word of their testimony.
And they did not love their lives
so as to shy away from death.
Therefore rejoice, O heavens,
and you who dwell in them!
But woe to the earth and the sea;
with great fury the devil has come down to you,
knowing he has only a short time.
And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth,
he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle
to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness,
where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
Then from the mouth of the serpent spewed water like a river
to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
But the earth helped the woman
and opened its mouth to swallow up the river
that had poured from the dragon's mouth.
And the dragon was enraged at the woman,
and went to make war with the rest of her children,
who keep the commandments of God
and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
